settings.title: Details
settings.content:
One size, 38 × 27 × 20 cm (approx. 15" W × 10.5" H × 8" D). Width is measured across the top; the body tapers slightly to the base.

Construction: vegetable-tanned leather on every panel, body, flap, handles, straps, corner caps and gussets. A single one-piece flap folds over the top and closes under two belted straps. At the centre a brass oval plate drops over a knurled brass post and twists shut. To each side a flat brass staple stands on the band, and each strap tip carries a slotted brass plate that hooks over it.

Carry: two short rolled top handles with a 10 cm (4") drop, for the hand or the crook of the elbow, plus one detachable leather shoulder strap adjustable from 100 to 115 cm (39 to 45").

Base: reinforced curved leather corners saddle-stitched at all four bottom corners, rolled piping around the seam, and brass feet.

No logo anywhere on the bag.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.content:
The Vivienne is a pre-order. Every colorway is made to order in the first run, cut and finished after you order it. Expected to ship October. Nothing on this page ships from stock.

Free shipping on orders over $75. Orders are processed in 1 to 2 business days and arrive within 7 to 10 business days after that.

Made in limited runs. When a run closes it can be weeks before that color returns.

settings.title: Care
settings.content:
Body, flap, handles and straps: vegetable-tanned leather.
Hardware: aged brass.

Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep it out of standing water and direct sun. Vegetable-tanned leather darkens and softens with handling, and the creases that come with use are the material doing what it is supposed to do.

settings.headline: Soft, Not Stiff
settings.body: It slumps when it is empty and settles into your arm when it is full. The short rolled handles sit easily in the hand, and the turn-lock and belted straps close it properly.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Vegetable-tanned leather, no canvas
settings.body: One hide, one finish, on every panel including the corner caps and the gussets.

settings.headline: A closure that actually locks
settings.body: A brass turn-lock at the centre, two flat brass staples, and belted straps that hook over them. It opens with a twist.

settings.headline: Made to order in limited runs
settings.body: Cut and finished after you order it. When a run closes it can be weeks before it opens again.

settings.headline: A turn-lock, not a magnet
settings.body: A brass oval plate drops over a knurled post at the centre of the band and twists shut. The two belted straps hook over flat brass staples, one at each side.

settings.headline: Two ways to carry it
settings.body: Short rolled top handles for the hand or the elbow, and a detachable leather shoulder strap when you want it off your arm.

settings.headline: Reinforced corners and brass feet
settings.body: Curved leather caps saddle-stitched at all four bottom corners, and brass feet so the leather never sits on the ground.

settings.headline: It gets better the longer you carry it
settings.body: Vegetable-tanned leather darkens and softens as it is handled. The creases are the point, not the wear.

settings.headline: Soft, not stiff
settings.body: It slumps when it is empty and settles into your arm when it is full. This is a soft bag, not a rigid one.

settings.headline: The leather, not the logo
settings.body: This is the Birkin-inspired shape everyone already knows, built in full vegetable-tanned leather with aged brass and saddle stitching. What we skip is the name on the front, and the markup that comes with it.

settings.headline: Two years covered.
settings.body: Two-year warranty on materials and construction from the day it is delivered. If the stitching comes undone, a handle separates or the lock fails, we replace it free. No repair fees and no shipping charges.
